Our approach uses enzyme-catalyzed proximity labeling and SILAC-based proteomics to identify the proteins involved in cancer cell interactions.
Biotin phenol (BP) (Iris Biotech GmbH, LS-3500) was prepared as 1000× stock in dimethyl sulfoxide
one dish was incubated with regular medium supplemented with 500 μM BP and 1 mM H2O2
For the generation of HRP-TM–expressing stable cell lines, MCF7 and MDA-MB-231 cells were transduced with lentiviral particles.
distinguish between the proteomes of bait and prey cells using SILAC labeling in a coculture system.

analyzed by reversed phase nanoflow liquid chromatography system (Ultimate 3000 RSLCnano, Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to Q Exactive or Q Exactive HF Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
Peptides in the mass range of 400 − 1500 m/z were allowed to be detected in Orbitrap in data-dependent acquisition mode.
The top 15 most intense peptides per cycle were selected and fragmented in the higher-energy collisional dissociation cell
fragmented in the higher-energy collisional dissociation cell with a normalized collision energy of 26.
A mass tolerance of ±10 ppm for precursor masses and ±0.02 Da for fragments ions were selected.
